description.zh:
水印提取类型。取值：

- **TraceMark**：溯源水印。
- **CopyrightMark**：版权水印。
description.en:
The type of the watermark that you want to extract. Valid values:

- **TraceMark**: tracing watermark.
- **CopyrightMark**: copyright watermark.

description.zh:
待提取水印的视频的视频ID，仅支持传入单个视频ID。可通过以下方式获取：
- 登录[视频点播控制台](https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择**媒资库** > **音/视频**查看视频ID。
- 通过[SearchMedia](~~436559~~)接口请求后会返回视频ID（VideoId）。
description.en:
The ID of the video from which you want to extract the watermark. You can specify only one video ID. You can obtain the video ID in one of the following ways:

- Log on to the [ApsaraVideo VOD console](https://vod.console.aliyun.com). In the navigation pane, choose **Media Files** > **Audio/Video** to view the video ID.
- Call the [SearchMedia](~~436559~~) operation. The video ID is the value of the VideoId parameter in the response.

title.zh: 提交数字水印提取作业

descriptions.zh:
- **请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解视频点播产品的收费方式和价格。数字水印为付费功能，数字水印的生成和提取都涉及计费，计费详情请参见[数字水印计费](~~188310#62b9c940403se~~)。**
- 目前本接口服务地址仅支持：**华东2（上海）**、**华北2（北京）**。
- <props="china">有关数字水印的生成和提取等更多信息，请参见[数字水印](~~2527021~~)。</props>提交数字水印提取作业前，请确保已满足下述条件：
  - 待提取水印的视频已经上传到视频点播中。
  - 待提取水印的视频时长需要超过6分钟。
- 数字水印提取作业提交后，请调用[GetDigitalWatermarkExtractResult](~~2587769~~)接口查询作业结果。
descriptions.en:
- **Before you call this operation, make sure that you understand the billing methods and pricing for ApsaraVideo VOD. The digital watermark feature is a paid service, and you are charged for both generating and extracting digital watermarks. For more information about billing, see [Digital watermark billing](~~188310#62b9c940403se~~).**
- This operation is supported only in the following regions: **China (Shanghai)** and **China (Beijing)**.
<props="china">

- For more information about how to generate and extract digital watermarks, see 

  [Digital watermarks](~~2527021~~)

  .

</props>

   Before you submit a digital watermark extraction job, make sure that the following conditions are met:

  - The video from which you want to extract the watermark is uploaded to ApsaraVideo VOD.
  - The video from which you want to extract the watermark is longer than 6 minutes.
- After you submit a digital watermark extraction job, you can call the [GetDigitalWatermarkExtractResult](~~2587769~~) operation to query the job result.
